title: HardEndure
description: Minecraft but harder and very brutal...
body:
# Can you survive a world that actively wants you dead? Endure is a hardcore-focused datapack that strips away your security and turns the very environment against you.

### **It's recommanded to use the latest version !**

## FEATURES:

-     Fragile Existence: Your health is permanently capped at 6 hearts. Every hit counts(1.1+: you have 3 hearts at start and you can get more hearts with vitality shards (max 8 hearts))
  
-     The Creeping Darkness: Stay in the light. The longer you wander in the dark, the more the shadows consume you. First, you'll slow down... then, something will come for you.(note: if you have night vision you will be protected from darkness)
  
-     The Shadow Stalker: A terrifying, invisible predator that hunts those who linger in the dark. You can only see its glowing red eyes before it's too late.
  
-     Armor Nerf: Your protection is a lie. Armor and Toughness are significantly reduced : -8 armor and -8 toughness.
  
-     Champion Mobs: There is a 5% chance for any mob to spawn as a Champion. With 60 HP, blue soul-flames, and massive strength, they are true run-killers they have 50% chance to drop a vitality shard.
  
-     Enhanced Golems: Iron Golems now have a massive reach of 8.0 blocks.(they are harder to cheese).
  
-     Decreased player reach : you have only 2.5 entity reach and 3.5 block reach.
  
-     Slower block break speed : your block break speed is only 0.5.
  
-     Slower attack speed : the default attack speed (4) is removed you have now 3.5.
  
-     Fall damages does 100% more damages.
  
-     Natural regeneration is removed.(you can use a campfire or sleeping for regen).
  
-     Added baby skeletons.
  
-     All Chicken jockeys have a diamond spear (probably don't work).
  
-     Players does less damages (-1).
  
-     Shield are harder to craft, they block only 50% of damages and can't protect you from explosions
    
## HOW TO PLAY:
 
    1. Download the .zip and place it in your world's datapacks folder.

    2. Do /reload to initialise the pain

    3. Don't stay in the dark.

    4. Don't trust your armor.

    5. Endure... and enjoy the pain :)
